name: MFT burn-on-sell pair drain
summary: Before _startTime1, every non-whitelisted transfer into the MFT/USDT pair burned the same amount of MFT from the pair's balance and synced it. With flash-loaned USDT the attacker transferred MFT into the pair repeatedly to burn its MFT reserve, bought, and sold back against the shrunken reserve to drain the pool's USDT.
notes: The burn-on-sell branch runs only while block.timestamp < _startTime1, which was 0 at deployment; the owner's setStartTime1 (to 2024-12-25) enabled it about 1.3 hours after deployment, so that config tx sets the age (rule 8).

Loss is the pair's net USDT outflow; the 1.19M MFT burned from the pair has no price and is realised through that USDT (rule 12). No other tx took more than 1,000 USDT from the pair between deployment and block 44200000.
